items.title: Nvidia makes its biggest investment abroad with Mediatek: Why it's a uniquely important deal
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is investing $3.5 billion in Taiwanese AI chip designer Mediatek (2454.TW). Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré explains why this deal is a particularly crucial element of Nvidia's larger AI strategy.

items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Could Be 25% Below Fair Value After Raised Revenue Outlook
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) reset expectations with a raised multi year revenue outlook and fresh quarterly guidance, after reporting second quarter results that highlighted the scale of its data center and AI exposure. The guidance reset comes after a sharp pullback in Marvell Technology’s shares, with the stock down 12.48% over the past week and 30.25% over the past 90 days. This comes even though the 1 year total shareholder return of 226.38% and 3 year total shareholder return of 266.82%...
